failure_modes.mode: NZ jobs enter legacy queues or wrong-country writes
failure_modes.cause: Broad SQL/context fallback or request tab trusted over job identity
failure_modes.detection: Interleaved country/worker/API/CLI and no-country queue fixtures
failure_modes.mitigation: Persisted job country, immutable run snapshots, explicit NZ capability and country-bound service routes

failure_modes.mode: Immigration/source constraints affect technical score or leak text to AI
failure_modes.cause: Whole advert/profile sent to scoring or old unrestricted enrichment
failure_modes.effect: Misleading fit score or prohibited content reuse
failure_modes.mitigation: Segregated technical context, source storage/AI checks before calls, no unrestricted NZ browser fallback

failure_modes.cause: Identical concurrent requests, expired reservations or automatic retry stacks
failure_modes.detection: Concurrent request counters, failed/restarted leases and budget tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Existing request-table operation keys/leases and explicit retry semantics; bounded task/transport attempts and correlated usage

failure_modes.mode: Approval survives document/fact/target change or import
failure_modes.cause: Unbound review state or copying capabilities in backups
failure_modes.mitigation: Current exact text/PDF/policy/fact manifest review; invalidate imported approvals; no submission authority in this phase

failure_modes.mode: NZ-only changes invalidate all UK work or private evidence leaks
failure_modes.cause: Whole-file fingerprints or blanket backup inclusion
failure_modes.effect: Needless regeneration/cost or unintended private export
failure_modes.detection: Protected UK dependency baselines and sensitive-marker transfer tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Project actual dependencies; never relabel unknown legacy outputs current; explicit governed evidence/artifact transfer and owned-path cleanup
